about_the_game:
In WESTMEN... play as Western Heroes in single or co-op multiplayer as you take back Western Civilisation! Wage war against an endless invasion of goblins, journalists, spiteful mutants and battle terrifying bullet hell bosses! Level up, power up, customise and conquer! Save our women!

The Epic Premise

The year is 1880!

The British invented a time machine and invited many great heroes from history to meet the queen,

but the time machine fell into the hands of the evil billionaire Goose Rogers.

He's sent a colossal army of millions of degenerate abominations from across time and space to destroy the west and steal our women! It's time fight back!

Play as great Western Heroes!

  • Charles Cornwallis ~ British General who fought in the Americas

  • Andrew Jackson ~ American Gunslinger and President

  • Johann Sebastian Bach ~ Germany's finest baroque composer

  • Queen Marie Antoinette ~ The last Queen of France

and more to come in updates!

Game Features

  • Play in single player or local co-op multiplayer with up to four friends!

  • Battle across 10+ challenging maps!

  • Encounter thousands of over 80+ different kinds of enemies!

  • Collect 100+ lore and quotes from Western History!

  • Unlock and equip 20+ unique weapons for custom and unique gameplay styles!

  • Level up your WESTMEN with over 50+ unique power upgrades!

  • Gain over 160+ unique cosmetic items to customise your hero!

  • Earn and spend Lynedelin to gain EVEN GREATER POWER!

  • Fight 16+ hideous and challenging bullet hell bosses! design by shmup enthusiasts

  • Over 32+ uniquely designed bullet hell patterns for enemies and bosses

  • An epic final boss battle against goose rogers!

  • and more content to come?

How to Play

  • Walk around a beautifully hand crafted map!

  • Shoot down enemies with your weapons

  • Collect XP and boost your characters abilities when you level up

  • Dodge enemy bullets! If you die, you respawn... but don't die too much.

  • Fill your BREAK METER and activate BREAK MODE to deal carnage and collect Lynedelin

  • Capture all three control points!

  • Watch out for bosses! They prevent you from conquering until you defeat them!

  • Destroy the sack, freeing the kidnapped women to WIN!

  • Spend Lynedelin and money on the hubship to increase your POWER for new challenges!

  • Go around the world! Save every nation!

What are you waiting for? Add WESTMEN to your wishlist so you don't miss out!
